title: ONFI NAND flash host controller, one target on the asynchronous (SDR) interface: Reset, Read ID, Read Status, Read Page, Program Page, Erase Block, Get / Set Features, R/B# wait with timeout

regs.name: CMD
regs.desc: Command; writing CMD1 sends it (the core takes it when the previous command is over)

fdesc.cmd_row: row address (three cycles, low byte first)
fdesc.cmd_op: 0 Reset, 1 Read ID, 2 Read Status, 3 Read Page, 4 Program Page, 5 Erase Block, 6 Get Features, 7 Set Features
fdesc.cmd_col: column address (two cycles); bits 7:0 are the Read ID and feature address
fdesc.cmd_len: bytes to read or program (Read ID, Read Page, Program Page)

regs.name: WR
regs.desc: Byte to program (Program Page) or feature parameter (Set Features, 4 bytes); the core takes it as the data-in cycle starts

regs.name: RD
regs.desc: Byte read (Read ID, Read Page, Get Features); reading it pops it. The core holds off the next data-out cycle while RD is full

fields.desc: the last status byte read (Read Status, and after Program and Erase): bit 6 RDY, bit 0 FAIL

irqs.name: FAIL
irqs.desc: a Program or Erase reported FAIL

irqs.name: TIMEOUT
irqs.desc: R/B# stayed low for TBUSY = 2048 clocks: the command was abandoned

notes: ce_n, cle, ale, we_n, re_n, dq_o, dq_oe, dq_i and rb_n are the NAND pins; they pass through unchanged.
The core parameters TP (2), TWB (6), TWHR (8), TADL (10), TRR (3), TBUSY (2048) and LW (12) keep their defaults.
